configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.displayName: Fast dev build (Ninja, Bevy bridge off)
configurePresets.description: Default fast-iteration config for CPU-only machines: Ninja generator, Debug build, Bevy tech-demo bridge excluded. Must be run from a Visual Studio Developer Command Prompt (or after vcvarsall.bat x64) so cl.exe/link.exe are on PATH -- see the Build section in README.md.

configurePresets.name: dev-full
configurePresets.displayName: Fast dev build with Bevy bridge (Ninja)
configurePresets.description: Same as 'dev' but includes the Bevy tech-demo bridge. Use when working on BevyDemoScreen or engine/bevy/*.

configurePresets.name: release-debug
configurePresets.displayName: Release with debug info (Ninja, Bevy bridge off)
configurePresets.description: CMake RelWithDebInfo: full /O2 optimization with complete debug symbols (PDB) for both the C++ code and the Rust physics bridge. The config to play/profile at full speed in while still being able to debug -- everything except the Release-only LTCG/ICF link flags, which are what make the pure 'release' preset hard to debug. Lands in Build/release-debug/. Needs the same VS dev environment as 'dev'.
